label: D2 after a1 -> S1 (common), following a recent unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D2, and almost only when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by the common transition (99.8% of activation mass). It does not fire at D1 or GO, after a2, or on rare transitions to S2. Within a1->S1c it is gated by recent reward history. It is strongest (~1.0) when the previous outcome was unrewarded, and it decays over consecutive rewarded trials (about 0.47, then 0.25, then off), so it is near silent after a run of rewards. Predicate: a1->S1c at D2 where one of the last two outcomes was unrewarded. Dev P 0.65, R 0.77, F1 0.71, mass recall 0.93. Using the bare a1->S1c predicate gives recall 0.98 but precision 0.40. Magnitude is high when prev_reward is 0 and falls as rewards accumulate. It correlates with high model value at D2. Only observed variables are used: action and state are known at D2.
